167
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the May 23, 2006/Jyaistha 2, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Heavy Industries and
Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water
Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Creation of uniform force for Income
Tax Investigations Wing
*541. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are considering
creation of a  uniform force for the Income
Tax Investigations Wing on the lines of
Customs and Excise Departments to lend
more authority and power for its field staff
during surveys and raids;
(b) if so, whether a part of the force
would be supplied with weapons; and
(c) whether Government would also fine
tune its non-intrusive methods of
investigations/surveys for betterment of tax
collection?
Implementation of VAT in the country
†*542.  SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the date from which Value Added
Tax (VAT) has been introduced in various
States of the country alongwith the names
of such States;
(b) the issues on which there is
opposition in those States where VAT has
not been introduced; and
(c) the action being taken to have it
implemented throughout the country?
Resettlement of families affected due
to Sardar Sarovar Dam
*543. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to raise the height of Sardar
Sarovar Dam across the Narmada in Gujarat
over 11 meters;
(b) if so, the number of villages/people
expected to be affected;
(c) whether Government have taken
necessary steps for resettlement and
rehabilitation of those affected families; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

168
National Project for repair, renewal
and restoration of water bodies
†*544. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the National Project
started for repair, renewal and restoration
of water bodies;
(b) the results of the pilot projects started
for the same;
(c) whether Government are considering
to enlarge the scope of this scheme to the
whole country; and
(d) the measures Government have
undertaken  to  ensure  the  proper
implementation of the said scheme?
Promotion of tourism in Maharashtra
†*545. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of TOURISM AND CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Maharashtra has sent a
proposal to the Central Government to boost
tourism in Maharashtra;
(b) if so, what effective steps are being
taken by Government to promote tourism in
Maharashtra; and
(c) what steps are being taken to develop
places of archaeological importance in
Maharashtra as tourist destinations?
Export of diesel
†*546. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
 Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Oil Corporation, a Public Sector Company,
has recently decided to export five lakh
tonnes of diesel;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether such export would impact
the supply of diesel in the country;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the amount of profit likely to be
received as a result of such export?
Rise in prices of essential commodities
*547. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
there has been a steep rise in the prices of
essential commodities recently and as a
result thereof the lower middle class people
are the worst sufferers;
(b) if so, what are the reasons for the
abnormal rise in the prices and what steps
are being taken to check it; and
(c) by when the prices are likely to come
down?
Loans to farmers
*548. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have approved
the release of Rs. 195.66 crores to enable
farmers to get refinance facility from
NABARD and renew loans to needy
farmers;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the amount released and utilized so
far for various purposes?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

169
Scheme for repertory theatre groups
*549. SHRI PENUMALLI MADHU:
Will the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any scheme for
supporting the repertory theatre groups in
the country;
(b) if so, the number of repertory theatre
groups are supported under this scheme;
(c) whether it is a fact that a few leading
theatre groups have not been receiving the
grant for the last two years; and
(d) if so, what is Government's reaction
thereon?
Shortfall in collection of education cess

Minister of FINANCE be pleas

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the May 23, 2006/Jyaistha 2, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and
Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
International services from non-metro
cities
3951. SHRI R. SHUNMUGA-
SUNDARAM: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the names of non-metro cities linked
to international destinations now; and
(b) how many more such cities will be
added in the near future?
Air services to Varanasi and
Kathmandu
†3952. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether flight from New Delhi to
Varanasi and Kathmandu has been
discontinued;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government have any plan
to restore the same?
Fire at Delhi airports
3953. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether breaking out of fires at Delhi
airports has become a common
phenomenon;
(b) if so, the number of times such a fire
broke out on the terminal buildings of the
airport during the last one year;
(c) the details of the losses suffered,
flights delayed and persons killed/injured;
(d) the persons who are responsible for
such negligence and create dangers and the
action being taken/taken by Government
during the last one year; and
(e) the safety arrangements provided to
avoid such fire accidents in future?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

898
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Air services to major cities
†3954. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether all the major cities of the
country have been connected with air
services;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) the names of political organizations
and people’s representatives which have
requested for the construction of airports
in the country during the last three years
and till date; and
(e) what steps have been taken by
Government in this regard?
Compensation to passengers for flight
delays
3955. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
recently a European Court has given a ruling
about guaranteeing passenger compensation
due to flight delays or cancellations without
making any discrimination between a
normal-fare airlines or low-cost airlines;
(b) if so, whether the Ministry will
also make it mandatory for all airlines
(including low-cost) that in case of
cancellations or delayed flights, passengers
are entitled for due compensation
according to the usual international
conventions/practices; and
(c) whether the nature of compensations,
either hotel accommodation or refreshment
etc. will be worked out in consultation with
airlines operating in India and the details
thereof which are publicized?
Amount spent on airport
modernisation
3956. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the progress of the modernisation
and privatisation process of Delhi and
Mumbai airports;
(b) what amount has already been spent
in the process; and
(c) the target dates of the completion of
both the airports?
Parking problem at airport
3957. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI LALIT SURI:
SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Airports Authority of India
are aware of the acute parking problems
being faced by passengers at the Delhi and
Mumbai airports;
(b) whether the authority has the
requisite expertise to resolve such passenger
related problems;
(c) if so, the steps contemplated to
resolve the problem; and
(d) whether Government propose to
engage experts/organization in the private
sector to resolve the problem at the major
airports, in case the Authority is unable to
cope with the situation and if so, the details
thereof?

899
Strike by employees
3958. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Air Corporation Employees Union had
threatened to go for an indefinite strike if
their demands are not fulfilled;
(b) if so, the demands of the employees
union;
(c) whether Government have initiated
steps for negotiated settlement;
(d) if so, the details of the same; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Wage agreement with IA employees
3959. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of turnover and profits of
the Indian Airlines for the last three years;
(b) whether the settlement/agreement
on Productivity Linked Incentives (PLI)
can be considered as Wage Agreement;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) if not, by when the negotiation
process for the next Wage Agre
